locations.note: Poirot inspects the tobacconist's shop where Mrs. Ascher was killed and questions her niece Mary Drower and her husband Franz Ascher.
Poirot investigates the death of Betty Barnard, visiting the Ginger Cat café where she worked and her family home.
Poirot investigates Combeside, a mansion in Churston, and recovers burned patient files that reveal the next victim.
